verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents spending caps, budget limits, or usage alerts for the OpenAI API. Rate limits (gpt-supp-rate-limits) cap throughput, not spend, and API key expiration and creation controls govern access rather than cost, so these are adjacent features and earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a metered API, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps, budgets, or usage alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
